# cmpjson compares decoded JSON values without expanding environment variables.

env VALUE=expanded
cmpjson object-actual.json object-expected.json
cmpjson env-actual.json env-expected.json
cmpjson large-number-actual.json large-number-expected.json
! cmpjson object-actual.json different.json

-- object-actual.json --
{"name":"alpha","count":1}
-- object-expected.json --
{
  "count": 1,
  "name": "alpha"
}
-- env-actual.json --
{"value":"$VALUE"}
-- env-expected.json --
{"value":"$VALUE"}
-- large-number-actual.json --
{"value":9007199254740992}
-- large-number-expected.json --
{"value":9007199254740993}
-- different.json --
{"name":"beta","count":1}
